title: Cut and publish 0.4.3 (LCLI-443/444: skill_source marketplace opt-in)
description: User approved cutting 0.4.3 now (2026-09-05) so the 4 remaining fleet repos (quest-cli, opum-cli-e2e, opum-agent, opum-doc) can flip to skill_source=plugin and delete their own per-repo SKILL.md behind it, per opum-agent OPAG-41's sequencing. Carries LCLI-443 (the skill_source config key and orphan-drift behavior) and LCLI-444 (this repo's own dogfood, including the buildNudgeBody fix). Follows docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md Step 3 exactly as done for 0.4.1/0.4.2: version bump across all 7 manifests + optionalDependencies pins, bun.lock regen under pinned Bun, Ladybug digest baseline refresh with negative-control proof, CHANGELOG [Unreleased] -> [0.4.3] move, dev->main fast-forward promotion, tag, dispatch Release with publish:true, verify all 7 registry versions, record in docs/reference/lore-cli-release-truth.md.

acceptanceCriteria.text: version bumped to 0.4.3 across package.json, all 6 npm/<platform>/package.json files, and the 6 optionalDependencies pins, in one commit
bun.lock regenerated under the pinned Bun version and bun install --frozen-lockfile passes
Ladybug digest baselines refreshed with a negative control proving the change is version-driven, not a content regression
CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] entries moved under [0.4.3] with a date
the stale-version-claim sweep across docs/ returns only its two pinned exemptions
dev promoted to main via fast-forward after full main CI passes, tag v0.4.3 pushed
Release workflow dispatched with publish:true and all 7 packages verified live on the npm registry at 0.4.3
docs/reference/lore-cli-release-truth.md records the new release with tag, commit, run id, and registry verification evidence

finalSummary: Cut and published 0.4.3 following docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md Step 3 exactly. Version bumped across all 7 manifests + optionalDependencies pins (commit 455d5f2, PR #582); bun.lock regenerated under pinned Bun 1.3.14 with bun install --frozen-lockfile passing; Ladybug digest baselines refreshed (canonicalExportSha256 only in both fixtures + the downstream report test), proven version-driven via a negative control (reverting only the version string returned the fixture test to passing against the OLD baselines); CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] moved to [0.4.3] - 2026-09-05 with a new Fixed entry for LCLI-444's buildNudgeBody gap; README.md version claims updated; stale-version-claim sweep returned only its two pinned exemptions. Promoted dev to main via fast-forward (git push origin dev:main, never the merge button) after a promotion PR (#583) ran the full main-triggered CI matrix (9/9 green) against 2378da5. Tagged v0.4.3 on that commit. Dispatched Release workflow with publish:true directly (run 33982343746, matching 0.4.1/0.4.2 precedent) -- every job passed including the OIDC publish job. Verified all 7 packages live on registry.npmjs.org at 0.4.3 (linux-arm64 showed the same benign propagation delay as 0.4.0/0.4.1/0.4.2 -- npm publish log confirmed success immediately, registry read caught up after ~90s, verified directly rather than assumed). Clean-install smoke from a fresh temp dir: npm install @opum-ai/lore@0.4.3 then lore --version returns 0.4.3. Recorded full evidence in docs/reference/lore-cli-release-truth.md (PR #584), demoting the prior 0.4.2 entry to history. Release was user-approved directly via AskUserQuestion ("Cut 0.4.3 now" vs "wait for a larger release") per the orchestrator's recommendation to unblock quest-cli/opum-cli-e2e/opum-agent/opum-doc's own skill_source flips.
